name: matchpoint-pride
description: Match Point Pride — academy operations console

scripts.android:sync: npm run build:android && cap sync android
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && scripts/android.sh bundleRelease assembleRelease
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.test: npm run test:unit --silent && npm run test:session --silent && npm run test:reload --silent
scripts.test:reload: esbuild scripts/session-reload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=node_modules/.cache/mpp-reload.cjs --log-level=error && node node_modules/.cache/mpp-reload.cjs fresh && node node_modules/.cache/mpp-reload.cjs expired && node node_modules/.cache/mpp-reload.cjs tenant
